observable_outcome: devbox run --pure -- make check is green at the candidate commit with gitleaks reporting no leaks, the secret scan runs in continuous integration on every v2 push, and the two-commit attestation protocol plus the serial-push rule and the known deploy workflow defect are recorded in the tracked documents.
acceptance_criteria: A1. devbox run --pure -- gitleaks git --no-banner --redact reports no leaks at the committed HEAD of the task branch, and devbox run --pure -- make check passes every target including secrets.

A2. .gitleaks.toml extends the default configuration and adds exactly one allowlist that is scoped both by path (the .agents/v2/evidence/ directory) and by a 64-hex-digit regex, targeted at the generic-api-key rule. No rule is deleted or globally disabled, and no other path is allowlisted.
A3. Removing the allowlist reproduces the 24 findings, proving the allowlist is what makes the scan pass and that it is not masking anything else; record the before and after counts in the report.

A4. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the secret scan unconditionally on every v2 push, through the common entrypoint, in addition to the existing affected and candidate-affected steps. The pinned action revisions in ci.yml are left byte-identical.
A5. ci/components.json gives .gitleaks.toml exactly one owning component by adding it to the environment component roots, and changes nothing else. devbox run --pure -- make ownership passes.

A6. docs/architecture/validation.md section 11 states that commit B of the aggregate attestation protocol is validated with make check, not only make candidate, and states that gitleaks git scans committed history so an uncommitted artifact is never scanned.

A7. docs/operations/v2-task-dag.md records: that checkpoints are pushed one at a time and the parent commit CI must be green first because scripts/verify-parent-ci.sh requires a parent attestation; that a task worktree must be re-validated after committing because the secret scan reads committed history; and that .github/workflows/deploy.yml pins jetify-com/devbox-install-action at a revision that does not exist upstream, that the deploy workflow therefore cannot start, and that fixing it belongs to V2-012 and V2-013.

A8. docs/operations/v2-task-dag.md section 5 names the required M0 evidence ids explicitly (ev-v2-025-contracts, ev-v2-008-candidate-aggregate, ev-v2-009-release-contract) instead of naming components that do not appear in the index.
A9. devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/contracts ./internal/ci ./internal/release passes.
A10. No file outside allowed_paths changes; nothing under .agents/ is created or modified.
constraints: Work only inside the assigned isolated task worktree; never commit or push.
Do not disable, delete or globally allowlist any gitleaks rule; narrow by path and pattern only.
Do not touch any evidence artifact, task-state file or evidence index entry.
Do not fix .github/workflows/deploy.yml here; only record the defect, because the deployment scope belongs to V2-012 and V2-013.
Japanese for the tracked documents; English identifiers in configuration.
